name: cuda_toolkit
role: the CUDA toolkit the tree's tools outside the graph compile, assemble, disassemble and demangle with (`dev_config.cuda_home()`: ratify's compile path, the binary gates, the lab, the measurement records): NVIDIA's redistributable components at the manifest the graph's toolkit is read by (MODULE.bazel's `cuda.redist_json`, by the same digest), unpacked into one folder, so every box has the same nvcc and ptxas without installing CUDA. Not put on PATH: torch takes its toolkit from the nvcc on PATH without following links.
